sources.title: Django 4.2 Python matrix
sources.finding: Official matrix: Python 3.8–3.12; Python 3.14 is not included.

sources.title: Django supported branches
sources.finding: Official branch lifecycle table checked; 5.2 LTS extended support to April 2028.

sources.title: Django 5.2 Python matrix
sources.finding: Python 3.14 supported starting 5.2.8; this does not establish DMOJ dependency compatibility.

sources.title: Python lifecycle
sources.finding: 3.14 maintained; 3.12 security-only; 3.10 EOL 2026-10. This is not evidence that every package supports 3.14.

sources.title: Node lifecycle
sources.finding: Node 18 and 20 EOL; 22 and 24 LTS. Existing Node 22 build not tested.

sources.title: Django database backend
sources.finding: Backend requirements must be checked for chosen modernized stack; Django generic backend support does not prove DMOJ SQL portability.

sources.title: MariaDB maintenance
sources.finding: Choose a maintained server series and pin its tested patch in A09; no DB version selected or started here.
